subject: general
question: Who among the following designed the India Gate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Edwin Lutyens**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Edwin Lutyens** is the architect who **designed the India Gate**.
 
• India Gate is a war memorial located astride the Rajpath, on the eastern edge of the 'ceremonial axis' of New Delhi, formerly called Kingsway.
 
• It commemorates the 70,000 soldiers of the British Indian Army who died in the First World War between 1914 and 1921.
 
• The foundation stone of India Gate was laid by His Royal Highness, the Duke of Connaught in 1921 and it was designed by Edwin Lutyens.
 
• The **structure was completed in 1931** and is a prominent landmark of Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Edwin Lutyens** was a renowned British architect, known for his imaginative adaptation of traditional architectural styles to the requirements of his era.
 
• He played a significant role in designing and building New Delhi, the new capital of India under British rule.
 
• In addition to India Gate, Lutyens also designed the Rashtrapati Bhavan (formerly known as the Viceroy's House), which is the official residence of the President of India.
 
• His work in New Delhi is considered one of the crowning achievements of his career.
